title: Domain-tailored coreset strategy for quant validation
creator: Priya Shah
description: Define and implement a reproducible, per-domain coreset and sampling protocol for production prompt calibration targeted at FP8/INT8 quant validation. Goal is to produce small, high-fidelity validation bundles per business domain (search, dialogs, summarization, codegen) that preserve distributional properties important to accuracy-sensitive customers while being cheap to run across model variants and quant profiles.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic pipeline exists to produce a per-domain coreset <= 5k examples that captures sequence-length, intent, and rarity strata
Coresets include canonical request/response pairs, masked PII variants, and replay keys to guarantee reproducible sampling
Automated eval harness runs calibration checks for FP8 and INT8 profiles across at least two model families and emits pass/fail plus per-cohort deltas
Integration with Redwood Optimize so quant-profile suggestions can map to specific domain coresets
Performance: generating a coreset for a domain completes within 30 minutes for a 30-day traffic window on the staging cluster
proposed_solution: Build a two-stage sampler: 1) streaming candidate extraction that annotates each request-response with metadata (tenant, domain, route, seq_len, response_len, latency, model_disagreement_score, embedding_hash); 2) offline coreset selection that applies hierarchical stratification (tenant->domain->service), rarity weighting, temporal decay, and a locality-aware dedup/shingling pass to avoid near-duplicates. Store deterministic seeds and replay keys so the same coreset can be recreated for audits.
implementation_steps: Instrument request pipeline to emit lightweight calibration records (schema+example) to a retention topic for 30 days
Implement streaming sketching service (MinHash + LSH) to produce locality buckets and token-shingle fingerprints
Design stratification buckets: sequence-length bins, response-length bins, latency-critical flag, user-intent clusters (inferred via embeddings)
Create adaptive reservoir sampler with time-decay and burst-suppression (per-tenant caps), emitting deterministic replay keys
Add anonymized folding: token-level hashing for PII-sensitive fields and policy-based redaction rules
Offline coreset selector: apply weighted sampling by cohort with quotas (head/long-tail/novelty), ensure coverage across config matrix (model family x quant profile)
Wire output into evaluation harness that runs generation on FP16/FP8/INT8 profiles and computes token-KL, semantic cosine delta, and response-edit distance
Surface coreset artifacts in Console (per-domain artifact with provenance, seed, and size) and allow download for customer audits
test_plan: Unit tests for streaming annotation and replay key determinism
End-to-end test: generate domain coreset from a synthetic 1M request-day and verify quotas across strata
Run calibration eval: target delta thresholds (token-KL < 0.06, embedding-cosine-drop < 0.015) across FP8/INT8 for baseline model
A/B validate that new coreset leads to equivalent pass/fail decisions vs. previous longer-run validation (size x10) in 90% of domains
Security review: verify anonymization rules remove identifiable tokens in 100% of sampled PRs
metrics: Reproducibility: fraction of replay runs that produce identical item set (target 100% within same window)
Calibration sensitivity: fraction of quant-profile regressions detected vs. full production replay (target >= 95%)
Generation cost: compute minutes per coreset eval (target < 120 compute-mins)
Time-to-generate: wall clock time to produce coreset from 30d window (target < 30 minutes)
risks: Overfitting: a small coreset may miss rare but high-impact regressions -> mitigated by rarity-weight quotas and periodic full-replay checks
PII leakage: naive inclusion of example content risks customer data exposure -> mitigated by token-hash folding and policy engines
Determinism drift: upstream data or hashing changes can break reproducibility -> mitigate with strict schema/versioning and stored seeds
Compute cost: LSH/minhash and offline selection could be expensive at scale -> mitigate with sampling windows and sampled sketching
notes: This ticket focuses on the selection and reproducibility guarantees; downstream UX (Console display and download) will be a follow-up if we hit the MVP acceptance criteria
We should sync with Security on anonymization rules early; schedule meeting with Maya (Security) and Owen (Privacy) in the first week
Consider exposing a lightweight "validation preview" endpoint that runs the coreset through a smaller quant sweep before committing to a full eval
